record.paper_title: String Theory on ADS3: Some Open Questions
record.context_brief: AdS3 black holes and Ramond–Ramond backgrounds
record.original_question: How can string theory be formulated for three-dimensional AdS-related black-hole backgrounds and for AdS3 backgrounds coupled to non-perturbative Ramond–Ramond charges rather than NS–NS torsion, especially in connection with black-hole evaporation?

evidence.quote: Other peculiar features of ADS3 are the absence of asymptotically flat regions, the presence of boundaries (when conformally compactified), as well as a rich causal structure, which makes it possible to obtain three-dimensional black holes after modding out some discrete symmetry.
They include the string motion in a three-dimensional black hole, which settles the proper framework to address the black-hole evaporation problem.
Instead of a NS–NS torsion background, coupling to non-perturbative R–R charges is also a relevant and difficult problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $AdS_3$ denote three-dimensional anti–de Sitter space, the maximally symmetric Lorentzian manifold of constant negative curvature in three dimensions. Quotients of $AdS_3$ by suitable discrete subgroups of its isometry group yield the family of three-dimensional black holes (the BTZ black holes), which have a rich causal structure including horizons and (after conformal compactification) timelike boundaries, but no asymptotically flat region.

(a) Provide a complete worldsheet formulation of string theory propagating in these three-dimensional black-hole backgrounds (i.e., on the relevant $AdS_3$ quotients, possibly times an internal compact CFT), including:
  (i) a precise definition of the worldsheet conformal field theory (e.g., as an orbifold of an $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$-WZW-type model or otherwise),
  (ii) a determination of the physical spectrum (including winding/spectral-flow sectors) free of negative-norm states,
  (iii) a modular-invariant one-loop partition function,
in a form suitable for analyzing the quantum dynamics of strings in the black-hole geometry and, in particular, addressing the black-hole evaporation problem.

(b) Formulate string theory on $AdS_3$ (and on the associated three-dimensional black holes) supported by pure non-perturbative Ramond–Ramond flux through $AdS_3$ rather than by Neveu–Schwarz–Neveu–Schwarz $H$-flux (torsion). Concretely, construct a tractable worldsheet (or equivalent) description of strings in an $AdS_3 \times \mathcal{M}$ background whose only flux through $AdS_3$ is RR, compute its spectrum, and extend the construction to the corresponding RR-supported three-dimensional black-hole backgrounds.
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on both sub-questions. The NS–NS case is well-developed: the worldsheet $SL(2,\mathbb{R})$-WZW description, no-ghost theorem, spectral-flowed spectrum, modular-invariant partition function on thermal $AdS_3$/BTZ, and a black-hole/string transition in $AdS_3$ have all been established. For RR-supported $AdS_3$, hybrid/Berkovits–Vafa–Witten and integrability/pure-spinor formulations of $AdS_3 \times S^3 \times \mathcal{M}_4$ with pure or mixed RR flux exist, and recent work (2023–2026) has analyzed BTZ orbifolds, near-extremal black holes, and mixed-flux backgrounds. Nevertheless, a fully controlled quantization of strings in RR-supported $AdS_3$ black holes and a satisfactory worldsheet account of black-hole evaporation remain open.
